component.name: TicketMan
component.summary: Track repairs, customers and stock for a repair shop

description.p: TicketMan is a ticket tracking app for shops that run their work through tickets. Staff check devices and such in at the counter, track the work, take payment at pickup and keep customer, inventory and photo records along the way.
This is the desktop client. It connects to a TicketMan server that the shop deploys itself, so the shop's data stays on its own server.

ul.li: The counter: check devices in with an intake checklist and a signature, quick search, the queue, and pickup with payments, sales from stock, refunds, store credit and gift cards
Repairs: custom statuses, a work log that bills time and parts, estimates the customer approves, warranties and storage fees
Customers: a status page they can check without logging in, and email and text messages when their device is ready
Stock and purchasing: SKUs, barcodes and labels, scanner input, low stock, suppliers and purchase orders
Running the shop: reports, an appointment calendar, a time clock with timesheets, and exports for a spreadsheet, QuickBooks or Xero
Staff and devices: access levels, PIN sign in at counter stations, kiosk mode, an audit log, and backups

screenshot.caption: The counter: a ticket, its invoice and the queue
Checking a device in, a step at a time
Pickup: the invoice, payments and what's still owed

ul.li: The server now turns away clients a major version apart, and the app asks to be updated
The web client picks up a new build straight away since it's tied with the server.
A basic payment implementation has been added but not tested.
Changed to one main server, multiple location clients.
